value.hook: read when pij-rs is 'command not found' or the shim says 'cannot run pij-rs'
value.title: pij-rs is a symlink into ~/pi-hacking/pij/target; a target wipe breaks it

sections.name: body
sections.value: 2026-11-11 ~09:03: another project's disk sweep deleted ~/pi-hacking/pij/target, which ~/.npm-global/bin/pij-rs links into, so pij-rs vanished from PATH until the prime rebuilt and relinked it at 09:58. The node pij shim still served ported verbs (report, list, whoami), but anything that runs pij-rs directly failed: fyi-read, ping, --json reads, spawn/revive, pij directory memory add, compact-self, and #213's Claude hooks. Fix: just rs-install from the pij checkout, which is the prime's job (niced; one at a time). Never link other builds' binaries (e.g. ~/pi-hacking/.s108-target) as a stopgap. Detect: 'command -v pij-rs' empty while the daemon still answers. Report to the prime with the time the bin dirs changed.
